text:
alex_sales: Heads up: ACME POC in APAC failing. Customer is hitting ap-southeast1 and getting 404 'model not found: redwood-7b-v2-quant'. Any ideas? @mike_eng

mike_eng: Can you paste the exact request payload and the error body?

alex_sales: Here's the curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2-quant","input":"Summarize..."}'
```
Error: {"error":"model not found","code":404, "request_id":"req_8a9f"}

jinah_ae: They're on a Dedicated POC and explicitly pinned region to ap-southeast1. We promised model parity with us-east1 for the POC scope.

kevin_infra: We haven't replicated the quantized v2 weights to APAC yet — storage + infra cost tradeoff. ops_bot shows the registry entry missing in ap-southeast1.

ops_bot: model-registry: redwood-7b-v2-quant status by region:
  us-east1: available
  europe-west1: available
  ap-southeast1: missing

mike_eng: Short options: 1) Switch the customer to `redwood-7b-v2` (non-quant) which is available in APAC (cost +40% but parity in output). 2) Request one-off replication of the quantized variant to APAC (infra work + approval). 3) Use a hosted compatibility variant `redwood-7b-compat` (lower perf).

alex_sales: Customer prefers identical accuracy and is open to paying more if needed. Can we do temporary replication for the POC?

kevin_infra: I'll file an infra ticket for replication. ETA ~6 hours for a one-off replication once billing signs off on the extra storage/egress. Looping in @hala_sec for any KMS/keys concerns.

hala_sec: KMS side is fine, but confirm whether replicated weights will live in our managed control plane or the customer's VPC. For Dedicated POC we can replicate to their dedicated pool; for Hosted we'll need to note data residency.

mike_eng: Workaround: set `fallback_policy.region_fallback=true` in routing to automatically route to a region where the model is present. Example snippet:
```json
{"model":"redwood-7b-compat","routing":{"region_fallback":true}}
```
Note: that will change latency characteristics.

alex_sales: Good. I offered customer two choices: 1) wait ~6h for replication, or 2) switch to non-quant now. They're leaning towards speed.

jinah_ae: They'll accept switching to `redwood-7b-v2` for the POC to avoid delays. Alex — update the POC scope + pricing and send the patch. I'll handle contract amendment.

kevin_infra: Filed INF-2379: one-off replication request for account `acme-corp-poc`. Link: https://internal/infra/INF-2379. ops_bot shows job queued.

ops_bot: deploy job 8932: model-replication-request queued -> pending-approval (requires finance sign-off).

alex_sales: Thanks everyone. @mike_eng — what's the exact API param to send if they switch now?

mike_eng: Use `model: \"redwood-7b-v2\"` in the payload. If you want automated region fallback, add `routing.region_fallback=true`. If you need a quick client-side patch: replace `-d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2"...}` with `-d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2"...}`.

alex_sales: Sending that to customer now. I'll also include the estimated cost delta (+~$0.07/token) and note that replication ETA is 6h if they want exact parity later.

jinah_ae: Customer confirmed: switch to non-quant for now. Keep INF-2379 open as optional.

mike_eng: After they switch, monitor request_id `req_8a9f` and latency. If new errors appear, paste request_id and full response.

alex_sales: :thumbsup: wrapping up with customer. Will report back if anything changes.
